🎮 CDPR Reassures Xbox Fans: The Witcher 4 Stays Day-One, Despite New Sony Deal

CD Projekt Red has just entered a marketing partnership with Sony for The Witcher 4 — but joint CEO Michał Nowakowski says Xbox owners have nothing to worry about.

🗣️ "All the platforms release at the same time – PS5, XB, and PC. No one gets left behind," Nowakowski said, confirming the deal is marketing-only and does not affect platform availability.

He also reiterated: "The Witcher 4 and our other upcoming titles will remain multiplatform."

📌 Context: the Sony tie-up raised eyebrows given Sony previously pulled Cyberpunk 2077 from the PlayStation Store back in 2020 over base PS4 performance issues (it was relisted about six months later). This time, Sony appears confident history won't repeat, choosing to promote The Witcher 4 heavily instead.

The Witcher 4 remains targeted for a 2028 release window on PS5, Xbox Series X/S and PC, with no firm release date yet.

🕐 Published: 25 Nov 2026, 23:35 (GMT+3)
📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle
👥 x.com/michalnowakow
